reason: I'd go for the free first visit, but paying $14 a kid plus $7 for the sibling is a lot when we're stretched and I can take them to CoCo's or the library for way less. Our shifts change week to week so a $45+ membership would just sit there.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I can't see why it's worth double for my budget.
would_change_my_mind: If the Group Mornings at $8 a kid really worked for my moms group and a few other families committed to coming, I'd organize one and pay for that.
